summary: All eight previous objections (O1 through O8) have been fully resolved in this revision. Market snippet S09 is now correctly reported as measuring 2016 online grocery shopping rather than digital pantry management, and snippets S06 through S09 are properly cited and evaluated. The support for the 30-minute weeknight constraint has been corrected to 2 of 5 target households (raw count: 2, weighted: 1.70), childless couple P02 has been separated, and templated text across interviews has been explicitly flagged. In addition, the target customer definition is now included among key open assumptions to test, P03's contradictory statements are shown side by side verbatim with lowered confidence, and misplaced citations have been eliminated. The discovery brief is thorough, accurate, and completely aligned with the evidence.
